review_description: Salesperson extremely pushy and felt like a used car salesman, turns out that was his old profession.As far as installation goes was quite neat and looks the goods.System has only managed to save roughly $20 per bill which is grossly under what was estimated.Wasn't until after installation we realised how much over priced they are compared to majority of other solar companies around (lack of research on my end). Looks like we spent about $4k more than competing companies for the same packages.Customer service was hit and miss, very good at beginning when getting system installed and online but after that have had issues regarding performance and all they do is come back saying "looks good on our end, use it better"

Sam Dihm visited my property and provided clear articulate answers to all my queries. Sam covered the panels, inverter, installation and optional finance thoroughly and efficiently. He reminded me regularly that Technaus Solar will be in Perth for the long haul to provide support through the life of this investment in solar energy.

Brett Johnstone the salesman was very patient and helpful. He answered all my questions and gave good advice.I even visited the depot unannounced to check them out and they were very helpful and accommodating.They were not the cheapest but I am happy I got a quality system that should see me through 10 years at the very least.The installers arrived on time and advised me that the planned panel layout was not the most efficient and changed it to maximise the output. Although a couple of tiles were broken the installers informed me and luckily I had some spares which they replace the broken ones with. They helped set up the wifi access so I can monitor the output via na app.I wasn't asked for a deposit, which surprised me, and was simply billed after the successful installation.I would recommend TechnAus and Brett Johnstone.

Using this company was the worst experience I have ever had, it took 6 months to get the system fully installed and the level of un-professionalism with the staff was unlike anything I had ever experienced to the point that we had to seek legal advice from a solicitor, once fixed we never received an apology or acknowledgement of there failings towards us, won't recommend to use them.

The quoting process from Technaus was very good.salesman was informative.Company organised the connection to the grid and that was done quite quickly.Installers appeared rushed. Very quick rundown on the inverter at the end of the installation .Installation not what i expected.Installer seen walking across one of the installed panels.

From the first communication with Brett Johnstone the salesman through to the final installation of our panels nothing but great service and follow up. Andy Forster the installation co-ordinator does an awesome job answers all questions and from start to finish was quick installation even with slight delay from Western Power. Brett is a salesman who doesnâ€™t believe in pushy, explains everything easily and ensures you are getting the best system.. installers turned up on time and did a expedient install.  Left everything tidy and explained the investor itselfHighly recommend Technaus Solar for good honest service quick install and friendly staff. Great value for money as well

Technaus was the most professional of the suppliers, from the salesperson (Brett) to office staff (Andy) to actual installers (Kenneth's team), nothing was too much trouble and they were all very helpful and showed lots of patience answering all my questions  Thanks Technaus, will certainly recommend you to anyone I know getting panels.
From start to finish this process was clear, informative and efficient..thank you Technaus Solar.

Technaus Pty Ltd did not provide a sale contract with terms and conditionsTechnaus Pty Ltd has avoided to  provide me its written guarantees for workmanship with terms and conditions.Technaus Solar is a member of Clean Energy Council, but it also fails to provide required documentations as printed on page 17 of Guide to installing solar for household, published by that council.The installation was carried out by subcontractors and is subject to the inspection. Depending upon the outcomes of that inspection, i might change my rating for installation.

The sales process was really good. The sales person came out on site, as requested, and did a proper assessment of the site. He was prompt in getting a quote back to me and answering all of my questions. He was also excellent in maintaining contact with me without being pushy or pressuring me to buy. This ultimately resulted in me choosing Technaus Solar.The installers were excellent. They were prompt, courteous, and professional and they did a great job. The installation of the panels and the inverter was done very neatly and taking into consideration my requirements. Even when there was an issue with the smart meter, they took it on board to arrange a replacement and have it installed a couple days later.My only disappointment was with the communication and interaction with the head office. Following payment of the deposit, it took days for someone to contact me to let me know timing of when I should expect installation. I ended up having to ring them. Once a date was set, railings had to be put on the roof. No-one informed me of when they would be coming so it was just lucky that I was at home when they turned up to do it. When there was an issue with connecting to the wireless, the head office called me and I felt they were a little aggressive in terms of making me sort it out.  All fairly minor issues, but it was a bit of an annoyance. They could certainly improve on their communication.

Brett was great from the moment we first communicated.  Offering a variety of options at different pricing to assist in choosing a value for money system suited to our circumstances.Andy was great with communication on the sales order and arranging the installation date around our availability.Caleb and his offsider was excellent throughout the installation and helped with setting up the system on the Solar.web app.All in all the experience was great from start to finish and I would highly recommend Technaus Solar.

Brett is such a wonderful person who is very knowledgeable and responsive with his replies (even on weekends). We will never hesitate to recommend Brett and his team to our family and friends. Installation and grid connection was also organised and completed promptly and in a tidy fashion (i.e. the install).
Great service, on time in all aspects, no sales pressure understood my needs.

Salesman was great with information and the quote. Gave heaps of information. Run down of the steps involved and what Technaus would cover was thorough. The fellas installing were great, efficient, quick and professional. Only hassle is the aftersales support. Had trouble connecting Invertor to my WiFi and haven't had a reply to questions I emailed. Also haven't been sent a receipt for payment, yet.

After the unfortunate weather preventing the first arranged install date and pushing it back a few weeks, the job went ahead and installation was completed and done in a professional manner and a neat job.  Also listened to want I wanted in regards to installation on the day of installation and accommodated the requests.  Overall an excellent experience and would gladly recommend (and have done so) to others.

Technaus Solar in Perth afforded great service from the sales team (Brett) through accounts to a quality installation. I opted for slightly better Panels. I couldâ€™ve got away with a fairly reasonable system for $3k but opted for the REC Panels due their quality & 20 year warranty. It cost me an additional $750 but that price for those panels was much more competitive than Iâ€™ve seen elsewhere. I have a mid range system at a fair price & am happy with my purchase thus far.
I would recommend this supplier. The sales person (Brett) was knowledgeable, honest and didnâ€™t try to upsell any unnecessary options.
Still waiting for Electricity provider to install new meter so unable to use system 6 weeks after installation- not the installers fault!! Output when tested on installation day was good.

Jason the sales guy is really informative and was street's ahead of the competition that I also got quotes from. Was happy to discuss ins and outs of the system with me and tailor it to our situation.

I think that all solar companies here in Victoria are struggling a bit from the demand since the Vic govt rebate scheme. Overall a very good experience. Just watch out on the receipts however as they issue one for the deposit and another at job completion, which does not have the initial deposit that was previously paid listed on it. This would not be a problem. However if you are applying for a rebate and need to include a receipt for the total job ensure that you included both receipts, otherwise it seems that you paid less which may affect your rebate application. Like I said not a drama but just be aware of that. The "how much did i spend" is after the vic govt rebate and STC credits have been applied.

So far, we have been very happy with the Technaus overall. From day one, they have kept in touch and been very helpful. Installation was a breeze. The electricians arrived on time and finished the job nicely without any problems at all. They were polite and efficient. They cleaned up afterwards and removed all rubbish. The inspector came about a week later and and seemed very happy with the installation. We are now waiting for the electricity provider to connect the system to the grid, plus for all the paperwork to arrive, so we can finally  lodge our rebate claim. Once again, many thanks to Finn and staff from Solar Quotes for all their advice and guidance, which made our Solar experience a breeze. We have already recommended your services  to a number of friends who are also looking into solar. Much appreciated guys!
Fast efficient installation. Because of the Victorian solar rebate I assume they were very busy and some of the paperwork was a bit delayed.  Jason the Sales person followed up promptly.
From the first meet up till completion the service delivery was prompt, informative and the after sales service was excellent
Found the company to be responsive and communication was good.

The other company you provided was terrible. He tried to email me a full quote and every possible system available in text format without ever visiting or asking what I wanted. When I requested for him to come out, he made an appointment but then cancelled at 10pm the night before and never organised any follow up. Did not seem interested in my business at all.Technaus was the complete opposite. Steve was great. Prompt service, answered all questions. Follow up and installation occurred very quickly and without any hiccups. Excellent service overall. Strongly recommend.

Disconnect between Sales & InstallersObtaining a quote and information from sales was very straight forward and not at all pushy. Unfortunately when it came time for the system to be installed, the installers said they couldn't install the panels on the roof in the way depicted by the salesman. This has led to an inefficient and under producing system that is disappointing and could have been done better. If considering accepting a quote from Technaus, I would insist upon an installer viewing the roof and providing an opinion on panel placement and panel size before accepting the quotation. Panel location is very important in order to maximise output and unfortunately in my case this did not occur.

Sales Manager was great. The only disappointing issue was that it took a couple of emails and a month to get the following: receipt, warrantee information, User Manual, and Electrical Compliance Certificate.

Salesperson Brett very goodInstaller Ben and his team very goodInstall staff are not IT people so do not get involved in connection of Inverter to your Wi-Fi network.  I was advised this before the installation so it was not a problem.  It is preferable that the inverter you purchase has a good readable display of power generated.I arranged for installation during winter as it is a quieter time.  Obviously in peak times, ie summer, all solar companies are going to be flat out.
I had an inverter changed

We had an overall very good experience with TechnAus Solar. The sales representative (Steve) was knowledgeable and patient with all our questions, the price was competitive for the components we chose, the system was installed one week after we placed the order by very pleasant and efficient installers (from Ramselec, a subsidiary of TechnAus) and the office staff too responded promptly and were helpful. (According to AGL) we were connected to the grid two and a half weeks after installation.(The only gripe I have - not with TechnAus - is that we are not notified when we are actually connected to the grid. On 6 May, we got an email from AGL quoting the solar feed-in tariff. When I rang to see if we were connected and when, I was advised they were "processing" it. When I called a week later, I was advised the connection happened on 30 April, a day after all the paperwork had been sent through. I must admit I have not yet installed the app to check usage and perhaps this would have told me).A big thank you to Finn and the Solar Quotes website for the sheer volume of information it provided that enabled us to make an informed decision with regards to our solar installation.

I found I had an alert on my inverter, and when I went to check it in the manual I found I had 2 installation guides, no user manual.  I emailed a request for a user manual and was sent a PDF that same day.Also, I noticed today that a roof tile was broken in the installation process which I will need to get replaced.  However, when they were here, one of the installers found a cracked tile on my roof which he replaced.

I checked and compared different companies and packages but this was the most professional one. They answered all our questions with a smile and patience over a period of time and guided us through the whole process. They explained all the options regarding different system and brands and made it easier for us to decide.

Steve at TECHNAUS SOLAR was amazing. He was very professional, knowledgeable and prompt. He was able to visit my property and work with me to come up with a solar system that best suited me and my families needs. He took time to review electricity bills and was one of the first installers to recommenced north facing panels. The quote with images of panel placements followed swiftly with accompanying info I needed for rebate application. He explained the process clearly and gave a price and lead time that was very competitive. The install overall went smoothly and so far I am really happy with the solar system and service (including after sales support) I have received. Thank you TECHNAUS SOLAR Team.

Have a problem with no lights in the garage where they installed the inverter. They said they would come and fix it. Took a while to submit paperwork to my supplier. And that was only after I messaged them asking what was happening.
It's too soon to tell how successful it is. The overall experience was good, but impossible to make comparisons. I've yet to get a bill for electricity.

We didnâ€™t go for the most expensive panels (LG) we hope we did the right thing.We took the advice that a string inverter system was better than micro inverters: Not sure that advice was the best. We had a 30m run from panels to the inverter, which was not ideal, either.

The person who came to came to do the site inspection and prepare the quote had good hands on experience so was able to discuss all the options for my particular install. This was very helpful. They were prompt with coming back to me with any queries, the prices were competitive and the installers were efficient and courteous. Would be happy to recommend Technaus.
Installation right on the day as appointed,Job finished within the dayFriendly technicians

The salesman, Steve Gunton, knew his stuff.The installation team from Ramselec knew their stuff. Finished in one day.The inspector found an issue with the cutout voltage of the solaredge inverter. Technaus's Vig Menon stepped in and got solaredge to lift the cutout voltage. He also managed to get the comms working. This left a very satisfied customer.Now waiting  on Ausnet to connect us to the grid.A good experience thanks to Tim Finns book and quote system.Thanks TimBarry Joel
Salesman was very helpful and prompt getting back to us with answers to our questions.

All quotes were comparable with a good level of equipment, so best price was chosen.Communication with the company was good and installation happened very quickly after committing to install.Install was done as requested and was done neatly with no fuss.

Sales person came out for an onsite visit and was very knowledgable and gave great advise with a few different options.Overall the system was a good balance between value and quality.After paying deposit was told installation date would be organised in January, however had to chase them up to have install date confirmed. When I contacted them, got an install date very soon but had to be postponed due to weather. Panels seem to be working well, took about 3 weeks for paper work documentation to come through for the electricity provider to get feed in tariff. Overall, it was a good experience, communication about expected time frames could have been better.
It is probably too soon to be able to accurately rate things like quality and value for money

Honest salesman (Brett), great and fast service at the CHEAPEST price of all my 5 quotes.I had the best experience with this company, once I accepted their quote it was all done in less than 2 weeks. For the actual installation day 3 guys came by 7:30am and were done by 11:30am.Really canâ€™t fault it.

Firstly prior to engaging Technaus Solar I spoke to 4 to 5 suppliers of Solar and was given conflicting information form incorrect information to sign today and we can install tomorrow. From the initial consultation with Technaus Solar I was offered a no pressure sales pitch. The information I was given was to the point unlike the others. Once I paid the deposit, the communication from the sales and installation team was second to none.  Everything was on time without a hitch. Installation team arrive on time and very efficient. Once installed follow up from the sales team was fantastic. System has been installed several days cannot be happier.My experience was faultless I would highly recommend Technaus Solar and would be happy to speak to anyone.
Technaus solar offered a good price. Fast install. Listened to what I wanted and lived up to there word.
Steve was very helpful and patient with all of our questions and the installers were friendly and efficient.

It took over 2 months from quote to installation. Firstly they said the quoted panels were not available, would I be happy with a substitute (I said yes). Secondly they said they no longer had the quoted inverter in stock because it had been installed in error on another job and that it would take some time to get a replacement.I was quoted for north facing and west facing panels, but when the installer came he said there was not enough west facing roof to do the job, would I be happy with some east and some west? I said okay. In the end none were installed on the west so by 5pm I'm no longer generating a usable amount of power, even though sunset is not till after 7pm. I am quite unhappy about this.Also even though it took two and a half months to install the system the organisation insisted on payment the day of installation (a Friday). I did the bank transfer on the Sunday and by lunch on Monday I received a call chasing payment. I explained I had paid and the man seemed happy. An hour later I received another call chasing my payment, this time a woman was pushing quite hard for me to say I was happy so she could close off the job. Not at all impressed by this. Further I don't recall the organisation ringing me back any time they said they would, I always had to chase them.
A couple of delays about taking an old water heater off the roof but once Technaus had changed installers, all done with minimal fuss.

My experience was ok, I dealt with the Technaus group in Victoria.What I've found is there's quite a big disconnect between the sales team and then the contractors they get in to do the work.I found Steve from sales excellent. He was prompt, throughly looked at the installation job, made great suggestions and took the time to explain everything to me.This was very different to the service I had on the day, the contractors were from a group called "Ramselec". Whilst they were nice enough people, their prime goal is to get the installation done as quickly as possible on the day.I've had a lot of work done to my house and am very used to the people who come to do the quote doing the work (or at least overseeing it), my experience with Technaus was very different and I assume it's because they're so busy now because of the rebates and they're adding more teams of contractors.Vig the installation manager was a lovely chap who popped out during the installation and called me on the day before, but he's clearly so busy now I didn't really get any chance to ask questions and any brief conversation I had with him was rushed.Examples of the disconnect were:1. Steve mentioned the inverter could be put in the garage, I was told on the day this was not possible because they would have to drill through a wall!?!? I really wasn't impressed with this at all and really regret not just cancelling the whole job on the day and sending the contractors home. The inverter is now outside next to my meter box.2. Solar panels on my roof aren't completedly flush, I look at the panels around my neighbourhood and see how nice they look. The standard is clearly lower here. Despite me sending a photo of this to Vig (he was clearly too busy to visit), I was told the job looked 100%3. Follow up for Victorian rebate has been very slow. The system was installed on 15th Jan, inspection was on 22nd Jan and I've still heard nothing (12th Feb). This was very different to the experience when I had solar hot water installed a number of years ago and the contractors chased up the inspector for the certificate4. The contractors Ramselec only lodged their job with Citipower today (12th Feb) for my meter to be converted. This means I'll probably have to wait another month for Citipower to come out and convert my meter so I can get my feed in tariff.5. The only regular contact I got afterwards was a daily request for me to pay my bill (I paid 5 days post installation) and two (polite) texts from Vig asking for payment. Payment requests seem to have been the only active communication I've received from Technaus.Overall, I think Technaus were probably once a fantastic company with great core people. But in my opinion have now grown too rapidly and employed additional contractors because of the amount of work they're currently getting with the Victorian rebates. I feel this has dissolved the customer experience.I wouldn't go as far as to not recommend Technaus, however I would advise future customers get 3-4 quotes from different places and ask for a site visit from someone who'll actually be part of the installation team before they commit to buy.

Slowest to respond for quote but best technical adviceInstall average..cracked roof tile and leak.Had to return to fix a number of compliance issues and make adjustments to inverter.Terrible back office support, no idea of customer serviceConstantly calling the office but no one ever rings backLack of staff training and empowerment.

I have given Technaus fantastic for customer service however I seem to have got them at a bad time and my original appointment was changed then there was a no show. The problem was with the original panels that I had chosen which they had not been able to get hold of, possibly being let down by their suppliers. However this should have been communicated to me.They offered me an alternative at the same price and scheduled the install within the week.The installers were great when they did turn up, and very conscientious and tidy. As a layman I can only judge on the results that I am seeing which have so far been excellent, around 40kw per day in Perth with an optimised system due to shading issues and a Solaredge inverter.I try to judge a company not so much on their ability to make mistakes but more so on their ability to fix their mistakes. Technaus came through after the initial blip, they were very professional, courteous and I have a system that so far exceeds my expectations.
Sal and crew carried themselves in a professional manner and worked tirelessly in mid 30's temp. Highly recommended!
The guys turned up early, were very prepared and began working almost immediately. They finished quickly and I was very impressed with the workmanship.

My neighbor used same company and was very pleased with them. I was impressed when speaking with them however they put the cost up by almost double from what my neighbors within 4 months so was a little disappointed with that. I havenâ€™t yet used the system as Iâ€™m overseas so it will be next month before I know how it is working.

After getting quotes from 3 other suppliers, I find Technaus price to be competitive. Jason did a great deal of explaining to me questions that I have in mind. Vig also did the scheduling quite well despite issues with Melbourne weather they were able to install it 2 days and got it up an running. I also look at the track record of the company seems to be quite good. They also got back to me within 24 hrs if I am not able to talk to them right away.I have yet to see the beneft against my billing, hopefully when it comes up next quarter I will see how much I saved, but when I did check aus net usage seems to be it is working, never had an fluctuation in power so far. I highly recommend them to provide your solar needs. Power production range since I had it installed is 16-45kw (depending if it is overcast / sunny day).

Bit of a long road to get there but installation was very well done and sales staff were very good. One false start and some miscommunications around reasons for delays did cause a bit of frustration but that aside I am very pleased with the final result.
The team of installers were very efficient and very willing to provide answers to any questions we had about the installation process and the system itself.

It's hard to evaluate fairly given that the system was only installed last Friday and hasn't yet been checked and approved by our electricity provider.... would be better to do this after 3 - 6 months.

Since September, 2018, after researching some basic knowledge of solar system I shopped around to find a trustworthy company for a solar system. Most of them just tried to sale without appropriately giving and/or explaining the complexities of solar products. And configurations. I nearly lost my interest to get the system. By chance, I found TechnAus in Melbourne and discussed with Jason, a sale manager. I was impressed with his diligent & professional attitudes and took his offer. During the process of waiting for installation, TechnAus regularly informed me when the system would be installed by Sonia & Vignesh (technician manger). Prior to a day of the installation, Vignesh came to my house to inspect my roof. After following day of the installation, Sonia phoned me to check if I had any problem and/or was pleased with installation boys worked. So far so good. WELL DONE. I hope TechnAus would not let me down, if something went wrong with the system. I will keep update, if necessary.
Very detailed quote, which was great I knew exactly what I was getting.Good customer service

I chose Technaus in October as they advised they could install in 3 weeks and could do a spread system (1kw facing east, 2kw west) with one 3kw inverter- i specifically asked to confirm that would work as the competitor advised the east panels wouldnâ€™t produce enough power for this type of inverter to function.After paying deposit and 3 weeks of me calling them for an installation date, in mid Nov they scheduled for 5 weeks time, 14 Dec. Then during that period I was called and told the 3 kw inverter couldnâ€™t work after all and Iâ€™d have to buy a 4kw one, which I agreed to.Rain was forecast 14 Dec and so installation was postponed, but I was advised it would be definitely installed prior to Christmas. They called last night to say there was rain forecast late this week - after a fine week there is a 60% chance of a few showers < 5 mm, coincidentally the last days leading up to Christmas - and I would have to wait till they reopen in mid Jan.This was the final straw so I asked to cancel my installation and was told â€œI will get back to youâ€. They didnâ€™t. Given the confusions and excuses I have experienced these last 3 months, at this time I have no faith I will ever see either my panels or my deposit.
Installation is due in mid to late January

I have chosen Technaus Solar Company because they are not new players to the solar market. I was quoted higher price compare to the other solar providers but still decided to go with them because Sales person (Steve Gunton) was knowledgeable and explained everything in detail before I accepting the proposal.Since then I was dealing with Vignesh Menon and his customer service is exceptional. He answered all my queries without any delay, went out of his way to help me with my concerns which is remarkable.I have no hesitation to recommend this company for any potential solar buyers.
Sales were really helpful. Communication past that point was not great. Installation didnâ€™t happen until we followed it up over a month later after being told we would be told next week.
Using photos of roof not accurate to plan number of panels will fit - measurements and clear plans required
Friendly and professional team work

I was happy with the experience, and got quotes from the three companies that you offered. TechnAus were the most engaged in the sale , explained their products well and gave the best price quote. Their service between sale and installation was minimal (I didn't hear from them for two weeks after paying the 10% deposit, then was told on Friday they're coming on Monday morning). Their installation was efficient and they have now given me all the paperwork to get my rebate from the state government.

Having a little knowledge on solar made me hesitant to buy one. When I stumbled upon solarquotes.com, I was surprised with the complete and detailed information that made me finally decide to go solar. Knowing the good brands and reputable installers are the keys in buying an expensive investment.So I was contacted by 3 companies in Perth as promised and I went with TechnAus Solar as they went for extra mile by having sales visit. They even price matched the other company that I was about to go with. Thanks to Brett of TechnAus solar for being armed with answers to my questions.

Thank you Solarquotes for putting TechnAus (Vic) in touch me with for my solar system requirements. Within 48 hours of my initial inquiry I was contacted by Steve Gunton, who I found excellent to deal with. From the first meeting with Steve right through to his follow up after the installation (just 6 weeks in total time) he has been terrific. The installation was prompt and seamless. Less than 7 days after the installation my system was inspected and signed off. Well done TechnAus. Cheers Stan

Sales was really great to deal with.. I had done some research already so it was a no nonsense meeting..Install team was fast, efficient and friendly..All round good quality for money and great service..Wouldnâ€™t hesitate to recommend Technaus Solar..System has been running for just over a week.. with zero issues..

The overall experience was great. The only feedback I would give is that the solar companies should get up on the roof to do a proper measurement to see how many panels could fit on your roof. They mentioned I could fit ten panels (two rows of five). On installation date I was told only eight could be installed, so that is what I went for. If I knew only eight could be installed in advance, I would have opted for more powerful panels to make up for the shortfall.

Very happy with the service and install from initial contact with Lee to the installation and workmanship from Brad and his team. Very easy process from start to finish. The system appears to be working better than anticipated.

I was told 3-4 weeks for installation but had to wait 6 weeks with no communication from the company, had to chase them up twice to lock down an installation date (minor annoyance). Installers were good finished the job in one day with no hassles. I am satisfied with the installed system and the sales experience.
Communication from company was lacking. After signing up, didn't hear from anyone for a few weeks and wasn't sure what was happening.
Good after installation service. Happy so far with the solar panels performance.

Lee came out on the weekend as we have a busy working schedule and was the only one to visit us to provide the quote. Answered questions we had on the day and was very informative.Installation appears to be done very well, impressed.We would definitely recommend Lee and Technaus Solar.
Everything good so far.  Only recently installed and still waiting for electricity retailer to re-calibrate meter for selling back to grid.  Will know more once all aspects are operating smoothly.

Would recommend that you make sure someone comes and measures your roof as we were told they could fit 22 solar panels on the roof but they could only fit 19 they adjusted the bill but still had that they were fitting 22 panels, I got them to correct that. The installers swore most of the time, argued most of the time, didn't have the right tools and arrived later than said (between 7.00 to 8.00. They were here from 8.4.5 until 3.30 as were arguing so much. Overheard comments such as... this job is not being done correctly so isn't legal, hope it's not inspected as it wont pass, we could loose our licence if that happens.There were 2 installers initially then a third person arrived after a couple of hrs as they were only going to be here for 4 hrs. The inverter screen fogs up in the afternoon for a few hrs which it should not.Not impressed with the installers at all.
Great experience. Any questions are fully answered and/or followed up by either TechnAus or the electrician himself.

I would definitely recommend Technaus Solar, everything was explained fully, all questions answered if I was unsure. They brought the date forward for installation to accommodate my timelines. The team who installed it were on time, polite, explained the system and extras to look out for, I could not fault them. Regarding the new government rebate and connection to the grid, a few issues with the paperwork but all was resolved through email and phone correspondence.
Only average because of over voltage problem with energy provider and follow up
Very happy. From the start Lee was very helpful. Tailored a system to work with our needs. Install was completed as indicated. Highly recommended

Jason was very informative at the initial stages of the process and I chose the unit on the size of it. It was a bit of a minefield to the novice but the advice and information was very helpful. The process flowed very smoothly and was relatively painless. I am still waiting for the energy supplier to get back to me about our rebate for feeding the grid but that is out of Technaus hands. Thank you very much for a smooth and painless process . Sincerely Derek
Prompt and good service. Jason Gowans is knowledgeable and polite.

There is a fairly long delay between deposit and installation I have had to chase company up a couple of times to try and get updates as to when the installation will take place. Selling product that they do not have in stock does not help!
The experience was made so easy by contacting you.And the quality install was so smooth.Thank you for your efforts.

From initial contact with the sales person to the final install I couldn't fault Technaus at all. Having been burnt in the past by unscrupulous renewable energy companies we were wary of making the same mistake and Steve put our minds at ease, recommending what to look out for, where to look for further information, how the STCs work, etc. The install team were great and just got on with the job with no fuss or mess.

Overall very easy process. Salesman Lee was very patient with my bombardment of questions.
